questions.question: Which specimen or diagnostic finding belongs in a reference record for Cryptosporidium spp.?
options: Asymmetrical pinworm eggs on a perianal adhesive-tape specimen.
Microfilariae in a peripheral blood film.
Malaria rings inside erythrocytes in a thin blood film.
questions.explanation: Oocysts in stool. Modified acid-fast stains at 400–1000×, fluorescent antibody methods, antigen assays or molecular testing.
